name: BirdSong & March
source:
A tiny interactive poem with feathers, flute, and flourish.

Welcome to a small visual novel where blue jays bark orders and chickadees mount a rebellion.

Where watercolor wings beat in time with bugle calls, and quiet voices echo.

This micro-visual novel was created for the O2A2 2025 Jam using only:

    One painting (public domain)
    One voice (mine)
    One flute sound (free)
    And a little courage, and several cups of coffee...and a few donuts. 

Over the course of three short poems, you’ll meet our feathered narrators.

And if you stay until the end… you’ll build a poem of your own.

I’ll even whisper it back to you. 

[from [url=https://spidertreegames.itch.io/birdsong-march]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一首带有羽毛、笛子和华丽的互动小诗。

欢迎来到一部小型视觉小说，其中蓝鸟发出命令，山雀发起叛乱。

水彩画的翅膀随着号角的声音而拍打，安静的声音回响。

这部微视觉小说是为O2A2 2025 Jam创作的，仅使用：

    一幅画（公共领域）一个声音（我的）一笛声（免费）还有一点勇气，几杯咖啡……还有几个甜甜圈。

在三首短诗的过程中，你将遇到我们的羽毛叙述者。

如果你坚持到最后……你就会创作一首属于自己的诗。

我什至会低声告诉你。

[来自[url=https://spidertreegames.itch.io/birdsong-march]itch.io[/url]]
